suite.name: Tx

kw.name: Open Bench
kw.msg: Set suite metadata 'Radio' to value 'TYT MD-UV3x0 (mduv3x0-m17)'.
Set suite metadata 'Hardware' to value 'TYT MD-UV390 2504BN02025'.
Set suite metadata 'Calibration' to value 'assumed, measured 2026-10-20 (d55ce4aa0a3c)'.
Set suite metadata 'Suite commit' to value '640a40ac39'.
kw.doc: Load the bench, its calibration and the radio file, and prepare the instruments. All five are mandatory and differ from tester to tester, so suites take them from the command line (-v BENCH:... and so on). `firmware` names what the radio runs, such as a git describe; `hardware` names the unit, by model and serial number, since units of one model measure differently. `dsp` names the DSP image the radio's audio processor runs, such as its sha256; it is mandatory for radio files with dsp_image: true, whose firmware states can differ in it alone.

test.name: 2m: M17 TX Deviation And Ratio Meet The Specification

kw.name: Use Band
kw.doc: Make a band from the radio file current: captures and transmissions use its frequency. Sets ${BAND} and ${FREQUENCY_MHZ} for the test. oat.expand calls it in each per-band test's setup.

kw.name: Bench Has Radio Console
kw.doc: Whether the radio takes commands on its trace port (the bench file's trace section has console: true): then the bench sets the radio up and keys it itself.

kw.name: Set Up Radio Over Console
kw.doc: Over the bench console: the mode, both frequencies on the current band's, the callsign when given, and the power (power_mw, else the RADIO_POWER_MW variable, for a unit that needs its own, else the radio file's console_power_mw, else left as it is).

kw.name: Set M17 Modem
kw.msg: Set suite metadata 'M17 modem' to value 'CHIP'.
kw.doc: The M17 modem setting over the bench console, ANALOG or CHIP (the HR_C6000's), recorded in the run's metadata.

kw.name: Operator Does
kw.arg: Set the radio to M17, ${FREQUENCY_MHZ} MHz, callsign ${CALLSIGN}, destination @ALL or empty, low power, no encryption
kw.doc: Ask the operator to do something and wait until it's done.

kw.name: Capture Keyed M17 Transmissions
Bench Keys The Radio
kw.doc: Whether Key Radio keys the radio itself, through the audio interface's PTT line (or the simulated interface), rather than by asking the operator.

kw.name: Start Capture
kw.doc: Start recording on the test frequency, for a capture that keywords rather than the operator time: Stop Capture And Measure FM or M17 ends it.

kw.name: Wait Seconds
kw.doc: Let time pass on the bench (at once on the simulated one).

kw.name: Key Up
Key Radio
kw.doc: Key the radio: through the audio interface's PTT line when the bench has one, otherwise by asking the operator to hold PTT.

kw.name: Wait Seconds
kw.doc: Let time pass on the bench (at once on the simulated one).

kw.name: Release Radio
kw.doc: Release PTT, as Key Radio keyed it.

kw.name: Wait Seconds
kw.doc: Let time pass on the bench (at once on the simulated one).
Key the radio for 5 s through Key Radio, then wait ${gap} s so the next transmission is a separate one.

kw.msg:

outer Hzinner HzratioEVM %symbols ppmfreq error Hzpreamble sframessourceLSF CRCpolarityvoice
tx123597922.983.40.4-3780.194121K0RETTruenormal
kw.doc: End a capture from Start Capture and measure its M17 transmissions.

kw.name: Keyed Instruction
kw.doc: The operator's instruction for 1 key-ups of 5 s.

kw.name: Capture Radio M17 Transmissions
kw.doc: Record while the operator follows the instruction, then measure and decode each M17 transmission (oat.m17.phy). Fails unless exactly `expected` are found. Each one's demodulated baseband is saved as a 48 kHz WAV, and its voice, through c2dec when Codec2 is installed.
${count} M17 transmissions of ${seconds} s with nothing at the mic, in one capture. Returns their measurements, oldest first.

kw.name: Remember Result
kw.doc: Keep a result for later tests on the same band.

kw.name: M17 Transmission Should Meet Limits
kw.doc: Check an M17 transmission against the radio file's m17 limits. `checks` names some of deviation, ratio, symbol_rate, frequency, evm, bandwidth, preamble and polarity, comma-separated, or all.

test.doc: M17-TX-1 and 2: outer and inner deviation (nominally 2400 and 800 Hz) and their ratio (3).

kw.doc: Stop the instruments and write measurements.json: every capture, check and operator answer, with the run's provenance. Absolute paths are made relative, so the file can be published as it is.

suite.doc:
M17 on transmit, measured and decoded from the SDR capture (oat.m17): the 4FSK deviations and their ratio, symbol rate and carrier, bandwidth and EVM, decoding, preamble, long transmissions, power, and the Codec2 input through the audio interface.
Limits are the radio file's m17 block: nominal values from the M17 specification, tolerances as acceptance criteria. Decoding uses this library's own decoder; with m17-demod installed each capture is also run through it, and with Codec2 the voice is decoded to a WAV. Set the radio's M17 callsign to K0RET first, or pass -v CALLSIGN:<yours>.
